title: Programme for Intervention in Paediatric Obesity
official: Programme for Intervention in Paediatric Obesity
summary: The PinPo program aims to carry out a comprehensive intervention for children aged 6 to 12 years with childhood obesity (with a BMI greater than the 99th percentile), fostering motivation and encouraging changes toward healthy lifestyle habits to achieve greater adherence and improved health. The program comprises 9 educational sessions designed by specialized professionals from various disciplines (pediatrics, psychology, nursing, nutrition), for a group of 10 children and another group of 10 family members and/or caregivers. These sessions are conducted in a hospital setting every 15 days, each lasting 90 minutes.

interventions.name: Intervention group for the treatment of childhood obesity

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children between 6 and 12 years old, with a BMI greater than the 99th percentile according to Cole criteria (2004).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children \< 6, or \> 12 years.
* Children with chronic diseases or following a therapeutic diet.
* Children with intervention in other centers.
